summary: Markets show a mixed, macro-driven tone: equities are stabilizing ahead of U.S. inflation data, while falling oil and a softer dollar have supported gold. Bitcoin is lagging risk assets and remains pressured by fallout from a major Binance security breach; no reliable same-day analyst calls for additional crypto tokens were verified in the available results.[1][3][8]
